sentence: This project studies how gene flow into a wild bird population changes the traits, survival and future growth of that population.
This project studies the genomic basis of plague resistance in prairie dogs and where that resistance is found.
This project builds algorithms that help current quantum computers model molecules containing lanthanides and actinides more accurately.
This project measures the speed of rock glaciers and how long their rocks have been exposed to learn about past climate and landscape change.
This project uses additive manufacturing, machine learning and digital twin models to design and test advanced materials and monitor how parts are made.
This project uses machine learning and quantum-level simulations to study how light creates and moves energy and charges in two-dimensional semiconductor materials.
This project builds a way to combine and check the communication protocols that let different processors share memory.
This project studies how engaged practices help researchers who develop robotic assisted technologies improve their research outcomes.
This project builds mathematical models of a digital twin that predicts how autism spectrum disorder develops and helps recommend treatment for each person.
This project studies how acoustic fields can arrange nanoparticles during additive manufacturing to make composite materials with engineered properties.
This project studies how the brain and behavior of learning from experience change from childhood through adolescence to young adulthood.
This project studies how biophysical signals at different length scales help heart muscle cells made from stem cells mature into adult heart tissue.
This project studies how aphid species are related and what makes some of them invasive.
